description: This file defines the WorkspaceInformation class, a service providing support and status information for workspace entities within Drupal, including methods to check support, ignore status, and deletability of entities.

classes.name: WorkspaceInformation
classes.description: A service class that manages support, ignore, and deletability status of workspace entities in Drupal.

methods.name: isEntitySupported
methods.description: Checks if a given entity is supported within a workspace.

methods.name: isEntityTypeSupported
methods.description: Determines if a specific entity type is supported for workspace functionality.

methods.name: getSupportedEntityTypes
methods.description: Returns all entity types supported for workspace.

methods.name: isEntityIgnored
methods.description: Checks if a specific entity is marked as ignored for workspace.

methods.name: isEntityTypeIgnored
methods.description: Checks if an entity type is marked as ignored for workspace.

methods.name: isEntityDeletable
methods.description: Determines if an entity can be deleted within a specific workspace.
